Thanks for the heads-up. A few things we need to clarify before we commit:

- Can you provide a single line item layout for combined licensing across EDR+MDM+Vuln so we can compare against consolidation targets?
- We're evaluating a phased refresh to avoid touching all endpoints during the Dec change freeze — see attached timing spreadsheet. Can you confirm whether monthly billing proration is supported if we split the renewal window across Q1?
- We may need an SLA exception for the EDR upgrade maintenance window (our security team requires exception language and a rollback plan). Is that something SecureWatch can sign off on?

I've looped in Rishi (security lead), Marissa (CS/renewals), and Dev (ops) to flag internal constraints.

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the detailed questions. Short answers:

- Yes, we can produce a consolidated quote with line items broken down by product and seats; attaching a revised PDF that includes the three-product bundle with optional add-ons.
- Proration for staggered renewals is supported; we typically create a master PO and then issue prorated invoices for partial-term periods. We included two sample scenarios in renewal_timing_matrix.xlsx ( attached earlier ).
- SLA exceptions: We can support a defined maintenance window and sign an SLA addendum covering rollback commitments. I've attached a draft "SLA exception request" doc for internal review (securewatch-sla-exception-request.docx).

Attachments: SW-renewal-quote-2026.pdf (revised), securewatch-sla-exception-request.docx

If helpful, I can set a 30-minute call with our technical account manager to walk through rollback steps and implications for the KV cache and agent rollouts.

Best,
Sam Jenkins
Account Exec | SecureWatch

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@securewatch.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SecureWatch renewal notice + options for EDR/MDM/VulnScan

Thanks Sam — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few internal constraints and asks from security/ops so we can land on an approach:

1) We prefer to stagger renewals across two quarter boundaries to avoid hitting the Dec -> Jan freeze and our end-of-year releases. Proposed windows: 2027-02-01 (EDR), 2027-04-01 (MDM), 2027-04-15 (VulnScan). Please confirm any technical blockers to that schedule.

2) SLA exception: Security requires explicit rollback SLAs and a contact rotation during the maintenance window (on-call names + escalation ladder). We'll need SecureWatch to sign the SLA addendum and accept a 72-hour remediation SLA for high-severity regression introduced by upgrades.

3) Pricing / credits: If we accept a phased approach, we'd like a one-time onboarding credit to offset the extra operational overhead (~5% of the annual run-rate). Can SecureWatch make that concession?

4) Contracts: Marissa — if we proceed, please prepare a redline with the addendum and propose the DocuSign path (I'm ok with splitting signatures across PO numbers if needed).

I'll be the security approver on this and can present to leadership for SLA exceptions if Sam confirms the rollback terms.

-Rishi
Director, Applied Security | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@securewatch.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SecureWatch renewal notice + options for EDR/MDM/VulnScan

All — thanks for the back-and-forth. Next steps I'd like to lock in this week so procurement can issue POs before the holiday schedule: 

- Sam / SecureWatch: please confirm in writing the 72-hour remediation SLA for high sev regression and provide the on-call escalation ladder (names + mobile). If you can add a 5% onboarding credit for the phased rollout, we can move forward.
- Marissa: prepare the contract redline with the SLA addendum and route to DocuSign (linked above). Use deal id DW-78921 and reference the staggered term dates Rishi proposed.
- Dev: coordinate a 30-minute technical review with SecureWatch TAM to validate rollback steps and KV cache behavior during agent upgrades.

If everyone is aligned, I'll approve the staggered renewal windows and issue two POs (EDR + combined MDM/Vuln) once DocuSign is ready.

Kimberly Park
